name: @adcp-protocol/fixture-test-sdk
description: Test-only harness. Pins a modern @adcp/sdk purely so the compliance storyboard regression tests can run a runner that evaluates context-aware skip_if. Nothing here ships, and the root project keeps its production @adcp/sdk 9.6.2 and its A2A 0.3 peer untouched — npm nests this package's conflicting peers under tests/sdk-runner/node_modules.
